objective: Implement deterministic event horizon and time-decay semantics for P11 news using observed_at, P11-D importance/topics and P11-E reliability without signal, timing, risk or execution authority.
scope: Use observed_at as the point-in-time knowledge clock
Define deterministic base horizon by P11-D importance
Apply deterministic P11-E reliability horizon multipliers
Emit FRESH, DECAYING, EXPIRED or BLOCKED state
Fail closed on content identity or time-order mismatch
Force BLOCKED or QUARANTINED reliability to zero horizon/decay authority
out_of_scope: Signal probability, trade timing recommendation, risk approval and execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: active task none, active lock none, open PR none
tests: observed_at is the sole freshness clock
HIGH importance receives longer base horizon than MEDIUM and LOW
BLOCKED or QUARANTINED reliability yields BLOCKED with zero decay basis points
decay basis points decrease deterministically with age
expired content yields zero decay basis points
P11-F evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P11-F policy/module/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P11-E remains canonical.
definition_of_done: Blocked/quarantined content has zero freshness authority
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
